doc256_storage_quality: 256 source documents/999questions,cap8 inputs. Whole-source-document95%bootstrap intervals. All plotted low-bit methods use actual packed GPU readers. Full FP16 is a reference, not a mathematical accuracy ceiling. The frozen1.8bit/0.5pp storage quality target was not met; shared encoder constants are additionally charged in eligibility. KVarN materialized quality-port storage is excluded from the low-bit frontier.
doc256_read_quality: All read policies own the same4.0679-bit representation per image. Frozen primary uses60.62%fewer extra logical read bytes and has a−0.312pp point gap to all. The point target passes; the95%paired interval[−0.818,+0.165]pp does not establish0.5pp noninferiority. CIs unadjusted; frozen primary superiority tests are Holm corrected separately. Logical tensor payload is not HBM; free output-length differences are controlled separately in timing.
prefill_effect_development_vs_confirmati: 2x2phase/reuse ablations at the0.5byte-budget setting,16full-residual-equivalent global cap. Values are within-dataset gaps to all, not cross-dataset absolute quality. The added-prefill benefit seen in development did not replicate; frozen primary labels are retained. Selection fees and later budget exhaustion also affect realized precision coverage.
external128_answer_strata: Fresh current-cycle128images selected before outcomes,64digit-containing-majority answers and64nonbinary-text-majority answers. Official MMF ten-annotator soft accuracy, not ANLS; strata are not an overall official-distribution estimate. These are joint K/V interventions, so stratum gaps alone cannot attribute sensitivity specifically to V. The DocVQA direction-code advantage did not become a universal external advantage.
fixed_tokens_timing: Six development images, three measured repeats per method, eight identical forced output IDs per question. Total 288 measured trials plus 96 warmups across 16 methods; 13 shown here. Input preparation, causal-prefix extraction, encoding and question replay are included; model loading is excluded. Both GPUs were otherwise quiet at each trial boundary. Bars are pooled median/IQR, not confidence intervals. Cap8 and cap16 use different image inputs. The frozen read primary had a 3.082s median versus 3.036s for all; lower logical reads did not establish end-to-end acceleration. These forced trials are never scored as task accuracy.
